composition_operationalization.v21_lane_gap: FLAGGED AND NOT FORKED: the v2.1 filing lane's RESOLUTION layer hardcodes v2.1 beyond what --hub-vector-basis parameterizes — one hub only (HUB_MODEL='8b', HUB_SITE_OF_RECORD=16), FAMILY_OF_RECORD='proc_k128' with 'proc_k256' absent from FAMILIES entirely, hub_map_dirs / vector_bank_paths probing only the frozen and v2.1 trees (--v21-root is sha-pinned to CORPUS_SHA_V21 and refuses a v3 root by construction), and a hardcoded '-k128' prediction id. The basis registry parameterizes only the HUB'S OWN vector (xi, for the descriptive companions). This builder therefore resolves webtext-v3 paths explicitly and calls the lane's arithmetic unmodified; it changes no repo code. Whether the lane should be generalized is the desk's ruling.

clauses_quoted.§8 scoreable pair: any ordered pair (A→B), A≠B, both endpoints in the CORE roster (§5), NEITHER endpoint in the race set (§7). The frozen count N and the full prediction-ID list (`v3-prediction/<src>→<tgt>/<arm>-k<rank>`) are written into the prediction artifact; the denominator of every gate is that artifact's list and never changes after it is sha'd.
clauses_quoted.§8 step 2: File ALL composed predictions — the of-record column through the 8b incumbent (pre-stated: predictions do not get to pick the winning hub); all four other race hubs' composed columns filed simultaneously, identically banded. The prediction artifact is sha'd and timestamp-attested BEFORE the first direct-pair fit job is submitted; the fit lane refuses to run without the stamp (the census no-peeking mechanism, made binding).
clauses_quoted.§8 bands and carve-out: ±.05 primary; ±.025 beside-with-teeth (see gates). The near-zero carve-out is inherited verbatim from the parent: any prediction with |â_comp| < .08 is scored MAGNITUDE-ONLY (|observed| within band of |predicted|; sign unscored). The floor-clearing count (|â_obs| ≥ .08) and the near-zero count are quoted with every gate readout.
clauses_quoted.§7 race slot basis: the identical shared slot set for all five race hubs — all scoreable pairs (§8 definition) whose endpoints are OUTSIDE the race set {qwen2.5-3b, qwen2.5-32b, llama-3.2-3b, 8b, gemma3-27b}, both directions, arm per the §3 rule, at the family of record. This set is enumerated in the prediction artifact BEFORE any hub leg is fit. No alternative basis is quotable except as a labeled beside.
clauses_quoted.§3.2 arm rule: Family of record = native::proc_k256 for instruct↔instruct slots; any slot with a base-model endpoint is scored in raw::proc_k256 (the parent's arm rule, inherited); arms are never pooled in any aggregate.

zero_scoreable_fits.claim: NO scoreable pair is fit anywhere in the desk-side webtext-v3 system at emission. The only fitted objects are the 175 hub legs, and a hub leg is not a scoreable pair (§8 step 1, §3.3).
zero_scoreable_fits.scope: the desk-side webtext-v3 system: every staging/webtext-v3-* tree, plus a repo-wide check that no fit outside it carries the webtext-v3 splits sha.
method: enumerate every fit_*.npz under staging/webtext-v3-* — 700 files in 175 leg dirs, 4 families each (proc_k32/k128/k256 + ridge). 175 = 75 main-lane + 15 half-a + 15 half-b + 5 llama-3.1-405b-instruct + 65 RAW-ARM COMPLETION (5 race hubs × 13 non-race instruct targets, the raw legs the §3.2 instruct↔base slots compose through)
parse each filename's SOURCE endpoint; assert the set equals the five race hubs at their sites of record {3bL14, 8bL16, gemma3-27bL38, qwen2.5-32b-instructL46, qwen2.5-3b-instructL26}
assert no fit_*.npz exists in any staging/webtext-v3-* tree outside the hub-leg tree
grep every cp2_summary.json under outputs/ for the webtext-v3 splits sha 6b0a6717… and the corpus sha b85f4d16… — 0 hits, so no v3-basis fit is hiding in the v2.1-era collection tree
zero_scoreable_fits.caveat: SCOPED TO THE DESK SIDE, and this is a limit of the ruling, not a claim about the node. This enactment has no cluster access by construction (desk-side CPU only). The node-side site-selection scan fits for the three §5 adds are hub-sourced 12-site scans, not pair fits, and were never pulled desk-side. A whole-system statement needs the desk's own node sweep.
